tasha: Quick alignment: need to finalize which Hosted API slices land in Q3. We have three customer-driven asks: reduce embeddings cost, improve chat startup latency for streaming, and a light rerank accuracy uplift. Can we decide prioritization + owners?
ben: Summary from sales: 4 paid pilots asking for embeddings cost cut (direct ROI), 2 want chat latency under 150ms p50 for short convs, 1 strategic partner wants rerank improvements for search relevance. Numbers favor embeddings.
simon: Engineering constraints: infra headcount limited. Embeddings path = model quantization + cache hints + tuning. Chat path = runtime fast-path + batching heuristics + streaming reliability work. Rerank = ML eval + small model swap + safety checks. All non-trivial.
tasha: Proposed lean plan: sprint 1-2 focus on embeddings cost (target 25-35% token cost reduction), sprint 3 start chat latency sprint (fast-path + streaming fixes), rerank as a small pilot in parallel if we can assign a single ML engineer. Thoughts?
anya: Ops/Platform note: embeddings quantization will need model metadata migration and a Dedicated compatibility flag. We should make toggle default-off for Dedicated until customers opt-in. Also need to update billing pipeline to reflect new unit cost.
ben: For prioritization I recommend gating rerank until we validate cost savings from embeddings. Sales wants wins they can show customers ASAP.
simon: Rough estimates: embeddings effort = 2 dev sprints + 1 infra tuning, chat = 3 dev sprints + 1 QA, rerank pilot = 4 weeks ML + 2 infra tweaks. Risk matrix: embeddings -> low model-regression risk if we keep fp16 fallback and run evals. Chat -> medium risk due to kernel changes. Rerank -> high measurement effort.
tasha: Proposed launch criteria (we should commit these):
```
- Embeddings: >=25% avg token-cost reduction on historical workload; no >1.5% semantic regression on anchor prompts; Dedicated toggle present.
- Chat: p50 <150ms for short seqs (<128 tokens) on staging; streaming reliability >=99.8%; no increase in error rate.
- Rerank pilot: +5% NDCG@10 for pilot queries vs baseline; documented eval harness and human spot-checks.
```
ben: OKRs alignment: Embeddings maps to cost-per-embedding OKR (target -20% by EOW Q3). Chat maps to latency OKR (p50 <150ms). Rerank maps to growth OKR (improve search conversion in pilot).
anya: Operational tasks: add Dedicated metadata flag, rollout plan (gradual 2-week opt-in), billing change PR, console label updates. Ops can own rollout with eng support.
simon: Action items: I'll open perf tickets for kernel-level fast-path and for embedding quantization. Assign one engineer to prototype quantize + fallback. Need bench infra access.
tasha: Decision: Primary = Embeddings cost optimization (immediate), Secondary = Chat latency (start month 2), Tertiary = Rerank (pilot, gated). Owners: ben (customer comms), simon (eng lead), anya (ops/runbook), tasha (product/OKR).
ops-bot: reminder: deploy window request submitted for embedding-proto -> staging on 1769000200 by simon.
tasha: Follow-ups: Ben to draft customer-facing note by EOD Friday; Simon to post perf/bench PR with numbers; Anya to prototype Dedicated toggle spec. We'll re-check scope at next triage. :white_check_mark:
